record.paper_title: Solutions to Some Open Problems About Four Sombor-Index-Like Graph Invariants
record.context_brief: Extremal SO5 and SO6 for connected graphs
record.original_question: For a finite graph G, let E(G) be the edge set of G and let d_u be the degree of a vertex u of G. Define the Sombor-index-like graph invariants SO5 and SO6 by SO5(G) = 2π times the sum over all edges uv in E(G) of |d_u^2 - d_v^2| divided by √(2 + 2√(d_u^2 + d_v^2)), and SO6(G) = π times the sum over all edges uv in E(G) of ((d_u^2 - d_v^2) divided by √(2 + 2√(d_u^2 + d_v^2)))^2. For a fixed order n, let CG_n be the class of all connected graphs with n vertices. What are the minimum and maximum possible values of SO5 and SO6 on CG_n?

evidence.quote: Problem 3. Find the extremal values of the graph invariants SO5 and SO6 in the class CGn.
partial solutions to Problems 1 and 3 are provided

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a finite simple graph G with edge set E(G), let d_u denote the degree of a vertex u of G. Define two graph invariants by
  SO5(G) = 2π · Σ_{uv ∈ E(G)}  |d_u^2 − d_v^2| / √(2 + 2√(d_u^2 + d_v^2)),
  SO6(G) = π · Σ_{uv ∈ E(G)}  ( (d_u^2 − d_v^2) / √(2 + 2√(d_u^2 + d_v^2)) )^2.
For a fixed integer n ≥ 2, let CG_n denote the class of all connected graphs on n vertices. Determine the minimum and the maximum values of SO5(G) and of SO6(G) as G ranges over CG_n, and characterize all graphs in CG_n that attain these extremal values.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work has determined the maximum values of SO5 and SO6 within the class of molecular trees on n vertices and the maximum of SO5 within a restricted class of join graphs M_{n,k}. The general problem over all connected graphs CG_n — particularly the maximum of SO6 — is explicitly acknowledged as remaining open, with the minimum problems also not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Maximum values of the Sombor–index–like graph invariants of trees and connected graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Attempts to determine the maximum value of SO6 in the set of connected graphs would be much more demanding, likely involving the examination of a significantly greater number of cases.
status_evidence.claim: Maximum of SO6 over connected graphs is not determined; only partial results (molecular trees, and SO5 within a restricted join-graph class) are obtained.
